mapper.sql: id, audit_type, target_type, target_id, reporter_id, reason, handler_id, action, comment, status, created_at, processed_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM adm_audit WHERE audit_type = #{auditType} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT FROM adm_audit WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT FROM adm_audit WHERE target_type = #{targetType} AND target_id = #{targetId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO adm_audit(audit_type, target_type, target_id, reporter_id, reason, handler_id, action, comment, status, created_at, processed_at) VALUES(#{audit_type}, #{target_type}, #{target_id}, #{reporter_id}, #{reason}, #{handler_id}, #{action}, #{comment}, #{status}, NOW(), #{processed_at})
mapper.update: UPDATE adm_audit SET handler_id = #{handler_id}, action = #{action}, comment = #{comment}, status = #{status}, processed_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
